headline: Congress named a Brooklyn, New York post office building after Mother Frances Xavier Cabrini.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 8320 13th Avenue in Brooklyn, New York, as the Mother Frances Xavier Cabrini Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 3, 2020.
